name: oc-puppet
description: Windows desktop-control MCP server (npx launcher): provisions the pinned server binary from the GitHub Release on first run, then serves MCP over stdio

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(process.env.npm_config_global==='true'){console.error('oc-puppet: global install refused - use npx oc-puppet@7.0.2');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(process.env.npm_config_global==='true'){console.error('oc-puppet: global install refused - use npx oc-puppet@7.0.2');process.exit(1)}"
